references.text: The Lord refers to the temple as a house of prayer, which is reflected in Jesus' actions in Mark 11:15 when he cleanses the temple to restore its holy purpose.
David's zeal for the Lord's house, which foreshadows Jesus' zeal to cleanse the temple, as described in Mark 11:15.
Matthew's parallel account of the event in Mark 11:15, where Jesus cleanses the temple.
Luke's parallel account of the event in Mark 11:15, where Jesus cleanses the temple.
John's description of a similar event where Jesus cleanses the temple, providing insight into his motivation that can be related to the event in Mark 11:15.
